name: Cadillac
verdict: Cadillac is a vehicle brand of General Motors, a US-listed carmaker whose only disclosed 5% shareholders are BlackRock and State Street. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: General Motors is a US-listed company (NYSE: GM); its 2026 proxy names only BlackRock (8.3%) and State Street (5.2%) among holders above 5%. Cadillac Racing's V-Series.R prototypes run in WEC as Cadillac Hertz Team JOTA, operated by JOTA.
